result: The four previously reported defects are corrected in the reviewed local capture. No new visible regression was found in this scope. Final production-image CI remains separate.

sourceProvenance.captureType: Local development server, not a production image
sourceProvenance.baselineMethod: Supplied by the CI owner; the capture itself has buildId null.

expectedResult: Muted controls remain visible, selected states differ by a visible mark or border, and keyboard focus remains distinct from selection in normal, forced-light and forced-dark modes.
method: Read-only visual inspection with view_image. Compared all 54 saved red and 60 green control crops in labeled sheets; inspected 12 green full-page images. Calibration images received a full overview and native-size top crop. Read raw browser reports and checked source hashes. No app, browser, network or Docker run was performed for this follow-up.

visualFindings.observation: Muted volume text and slider are as visible as their unmuted equivalents in all three modes. The speaker icon changes between a cross and sound waves, so the mute state still has a separate visible cue.

Forced-light selected party cards have black checkmarks and forced-dark cards have white checkmarks. Unselected interiors are blank. Space selection and clearing crops show both states. The normal theme retains its green marker.
Only the selected shop tab has an underline in forced-light and forced-dark modes. The normal theme retains its gold selected state.
The selected calibration filter has a double border. Unselected filters have a solid border in both forced-color modes. The normal theme retains its prior selected style.

focusReview.result: The tested unselected party card, shop tab and calibration filter gain a separate outer outline on keyboard focus in all three modes. The selected marker remains distinct from this outline.

fullPageReview: The corrected controls fit their surrounding layouts. Headings, labels, item artwork and the inspected page content remain visible. This targeted review found no new layout regression.
measuredEvidenceLimits: The green report records 117 passing targeted painting checks. Red has 102 checks and 16 failures; test counts differ because green adds mute icon, label, restoration and normal-theme volume checks.
The pixel method compares pixels against the most common crop color. Its maximum contrast is the highest sampled pixel ratio, not a minimum text contrast or a page-wide measurement.
Green raw axe output still has excluded forced-light color-contrast results and incomplete checks. A zero gate failure count is not a claim that all axe checks passed.
limits: This review covers one Chromium version, one desktop viewport and three recorded color modes. It does not certify other browsers, physical Windows high-contrast themes or smaller screens.
The report has no build ID and the screenshots show the development indicator. Source hashes in the capture summary bind this local correction; they do not prove the final production image.
This follow-up covers four identified defects and their nearby layouts. It is not a full accessibility or page-wide contrast audit.
Calibration table rows were viewed as a full-page overview; the native-size check covered the top section and controls, not every row.
The saved crops and browser report support the recorded state and focus checks. This reviewer did not operate a browser or test a screen reader.
